actions.text: Good morning, Idumota, this is Radio Agbado on the pirate band, and today's forecast is theft with scattered lawyers. At midnight Nimbus Holdings filed a patent on Mama Iyabo's purple water yam, kicked open the seed bank, and flew the tubers up the irrigation tower. Her grandchild is standing in the beds with a taped-up deck and a full bowl of anger. The paid rain over the island runs out soon, so drink your zobo and go get those seeds.
